This suggests a possible regulatory pathway involving phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate metabolism and its downstream effects on inflammatory signaling. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the relationships are inferred through target-based associations, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct involvement of Oblonganoside C in modulating the Interleukin-1 receptor antagonist protein.
